description: This file defines the UriInterface interface as per PSR-7, outlining methods for URI handling in HTTP messages, including getters and setters for URI components.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: Interface representing a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) according to RFC 3986, providing methods to access and modify URI components immutably.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme component of the URI, normalized to lowercase, or an empty string if not present.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves the authority component of the URI in '[user-info@]host[:port]' format or an empty string if not present.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the user information component, including username and optional password, or an empty string if not present.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the host component of the URI, normalized to lowercase, or an empty string if not present.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port component as an integer, or null if not set or standard for the scheme.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path component of the URI, percent-encoded.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query string component of the URI, percent-encoded.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment component of the URI, percent-encoded.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified user info, including optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new UriInterface instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full URI as a string, combining all components appropriately.
